No Escalation clauses.Welcome to this gracious, impeccably maintained home, perfectly situated on a serene, one-acre flat lot in a lovely neighborhood with no through traffic. Offering the ideal combination of comfort & convenience, this inviting residence features 3 bedrooms & 2.5 baths with a light-filled, open main level designed for everyday living & effortless entertaining. The spacious living room centers around a cozy fireplace, while the kitchen features clean-lined wood cabinetry, a functional island, & easy entry to a fabulous three-season porch-perfect for enjoying tranquil views of the landscaped gardens. The primary suite includes an en-suite bath with double sinks; skylights fill the bedroom with natural light. Two additional bedrooms flank a versatile sitting room that can serve as a library, office, or relaxation area. The lower level offers a generous family/playroom, laundry area, & a sunlit additional room ideal for a second office, art studio, or craft space. Direct access to the two-car garage adds everyday convenience, & the home's solid construction ensures lasting quality. Step outside to discover a beautifully maintained garden with blooming shrubs, a patio for lounging, & a spacious lawn for play. A whole-house generator provides peace of mind year-round. Located near Coleytown schools and just minutes from town, this property offers a private, walkable neighborhood with easy access town.
